principles: Honest record: state what is proven and what is not
Reference raw evidence, do not duplicate
drivers: The repo needs an auditable in-repo record of the effectiveness-proof OUTCOME, not just the external paper folder

options.name: Manual-source decision-doc via decision_doc flow (chosen)
pros: lands in docs/requirements/decisions/ with provenance + review
cons: Structured decision-doc fields fit a decision-record framing, not free-form prose (acceptable)

options.name: Copy all lattice-Paper docs into the repo
cons: Duplicates raw CSV/figure/script files; bloats the repo; drifts from the paper workspace

options.name: Leave the record only in lattice-Paper + git history
cons: No in-repo auditable record of the OUTCOME; the operator explicitly asked for one

rationale: A manual-source decision-doc landed via the established decision_doc flow gives an auditable in-repo record matching the B-1480 convention, while referencing (not duplicating) the lattice-Paper raw evidence; copying everything would bloat the repo and leaving it external fails the operator's explicit request.

preMortem.trigger: Story IDs / commit / live numbers are typed wrong or drift.
preMortem.mitigation: CHK-002 re-verifies each story ID, the commit, and the live numbers on main before DONE.
Author English/ASCII-only; CHK-002 greps for non-ASCII.

preMortem.trigger: Stating the causal hints-improve-outcomes result as proven.
preMortem.consequence: Dishonest record contradicting the work's own caveats.
preMortem.mitigation: The honesty guards section explicitly marks the causal claim as deferred to the forward RCT; observational != causal.
